title: Line sketch: Cosmic Spirals
description: Black-and-white ink line sketch on white paper — pure contour and edge drawing with no color fills. Edge-traced line art of: Vibrant swirling celestial orbs float across a gradient space backdrop, evoking distant galaxies or planets. Smooth glowing blends and luminous effects suggest a technique (derived from painting #89).
